user_text: Hi, I'm here on a school trip with Michael Haas. Can you show me a painting with many colors?

robot_messages.main: I think you will love Water Lilies by Claude Monet! Look at all those water flowers! Monet painted this pond over and over because he loved how the light changed the colors every day. Can you see the reflections in the water? The painting is full of soft blues, greens, and violets that blend together like a dream. You can find it right to the left of Las Meninas.
robot_messages.follow_up: Did you like the colors in Water Lilies?
